note: Registered while walking Analytics in Part 5 (2026-09-02). Every state here was reached by hand in a browser during that pass and is written down so the reaching is repeatable rather than remembered — the four interactive surfaces this Part ADDED are exactly the ones no instrument could see before it, because a div and a button with the same class are identical to a page diff until you press one. Each `expect` is a selector observed on the page after the steps ran, never guessed: a state that cannot name its own subject reports a clean result for the default view.

states.note: Addressed by the CELL and by its words, not the row: a coordinate click on a <tr> lands wherever its centre falls, and the checkbox cell stops propagation. The row handler is what opens the drawer, and it fires from any cell that does not.
